question: Which ordering correctly ranks the countries by 2022 CO2 per capita, highest to lowest? (A) US, Germany, China, India, Brazil (B) US, China, Germany, Brazil, India (C) China, Germany, US, Brazil, India. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: B (B). Bait: A (A).
